messages:
emily: sharing a new probe 1 1: banded heatmap with thin separators between buckets and inline per-band annotations for sample rate + top-percentile callout. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/banded-heatmap-annot.png
ryan: visually that separator helps parse dense noise. question: do separators imply discrete buckets? our backend supports continuous bins.
emily: separators are purely visual. we should add a legend note: 'visual bands for readability; buckets are continuous'.
jenn: Accessibility: separators must not be the only cue. also read out band boundaries when keyboard-focused. aria-label: 'band 3 of 12, 200-300ms, sampling 1-in-10 (10%)'.
omar: microcopy: instead of 'sampling', use 'Sampled' prefix in the annotation: 'Sampled — 1-in-10 (10%)' so it's clear in short space.
ryan: p95 callout: propose a tiny inline sparkline overlay with a pill: 'p95: 210ms (sampled)' that collapses on mobile. make pill tappable to open trace list.
emily: pill color idea: amber for sampled, teal for full. ensure 4.5:1 contrast on text.
jenn: keyboard flows: tab into a band, press Enter to expand traces. when expanded, focus should go to first trace and AT should announce 'Expanded band showing representative traces, press Escape to return'. document in AX checklist.
omar: performance question: fetching representative traces per band can be heavy. suggest fetch-on-demand (click), and cache results for 2m. show skeleton rows.
emily: agreed. UX note: add a tiny disclosure: 'Representative traces are limited to first 10 results' to set expectations.
ryan: sampling controls idea: small 'override' icon at band level that opens a quick slider (1-in-N) with 'Apply to band' vs 'Apply globally'. default 'Apply to band (temporary)'.
jenn: accessibility/copy: menu items need clear labels: 'Override sampling for this band (temporary)' and 'Pin override for this band (persistent)'. pin should trigger audit event.
omar: ops asks for undo affordance when pinning, and auto-expire option. also we need to clearly flag any metric that changes provenance after override e.g., badge 'p95 (recomputed)'.
emily: animation: band expand should animate height 120ms and fade child rows 80ms. respect prefers-reduced-motion. ensure focusable elements are visible during animation.
ryan: heatmap mode toggle: discrete bands vs continuous. suggest an inline toggle 'Banding: On/Off' in legend. default on for compact views.
jenn: screen reader behavior: when toggle is flipped, announce 'Banding enabled' and read summary 'Currently showing 12 bands, range X-Y ms'. avoid verbose announcements.
omar: color scale: propose lowering saturation at peak bins and adding an outline on hover to improve small-screen readability. also add a high-contrast theme toggle in settings.
emily: small copy tweak for p95 tooltip: '95th percentile latency (p95) — higher values indicate slower requests. Computed on: Sampled/Full.' short and explicit.
ryan: timepicker interaction: if user adjusts range mid-inspection, keep a 'sticky band focus' if the same band index still exists; otherwise collapse. show a toast 'Context changed, band focus closed' with undo.
jenn: ARIA nit: the band pill that says 'Sampled' should have role='status' and aria-live='polite' so screen reader users get notified when provenance changes.
omar: one more ops requirement: any per-band override must emit analytics: {user, band_id, old_rate, new_rate, scope, pinned, timestamp}. include this in PR description.
emily: QA checklist for PR: band keyboard navigation, ARIA announcements on toggle, band expand fetch debounce, sample override analytics, pill contrast, reduced-motion paths, toast undo behavior, mobile collapse of pill.
ax-bot: Reminder: telemetry returns sample_rate as float and sample_source. UI must render as '1-in-N (X%)' and show source when present. Also enforce that last_message_ts >= first_message_ts.
emily: thanks all 1 I'll post updated mock with the banded legend treatment, animation timings, and the QA checklist in the PR. tagging @ryan @jenn @omar for review :sparkles:
